DOXA-009c8485ae20969LOWCookie without SameSite attributehttp://127.0.0.1:8080Session managementConfirmed vulnerabilityHighhttpcurl2026-11-16T06:30:55ZA07:2021 Identification and Authentication FailuresNot scored: no directly demonstrated impact, or insufficient evidence for a defensible CVSS vector.Without SameSite, cookies are sent on cross-site requests in older browsers, aiding CSRF.Session cookies may be exposed to script access or sent over insecure channels, increasing the risk of session theft.Cookie names (values not stored): PHPSESSID PHPSESSID security Set SameSite=Lax or Strict (None only with Secure when required).Modern browsers default to Lax, reducing the practical risk.
